definitions.short: the bellows (i.e. blower) of a forge
definitions.full: H4647. mappuach מַמֻּחַ noun masculine bellows ; — מ ׳נָחַר Jer 6:29 (figurative of vain prophetic labour).

occurrences.englishText: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.
